_note: FICTIONAL countries for the sandbox. None of these places exist. Populations are invented.

countries.name: Nordhavia
countries.notes: Fictional. High incomes, strong institutions, small but non-zero rates of police mistreatment, discrimination and surveillance.

countries.name: Merovia
countries.notes: Fictional. Elections exist but space for dissent has narrowed over time.

countries.name: Tarsenne
countries.notes: Fictional. Schools and clinics reach almost everyone; independent surveys on policing and opinion are not allowed, so several indicators are missing.

countries.name: Qarvesh
countries.notes: Fictional. Ongoing armed conflict; household surveys stopped, so several indicators are missing.

countries.name: Ubendi
countries.notes: Fictional. Peaceful transfers of power, low incomes, mostly rural and informal work.

countries.name: Solmira
countries.notes: Fictional. Large gaps between income groups; high homicide rate.

countries.name: Pelora
countries.notes: Fictional. Small population, high exposure to storms, high emigration; some series start late.

countries.name: Drevania
countries.notes: Fictional. War ended in the late 1990s; almost no survey data before 2000.
